column1: # Mario Kart World (Switch 2, update v917504 = 1.8.0). In bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive), SDK 21.4.0, NVN2 (the Switch 2's NVN); modules main + subsdk0 (movie) + subsdk1 (libc) + sdk.
# Packed from a dump folder (base/, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH, Nin_Ounce_NVN2).
# the program ID in the update's main.npdm (ACI0), the same as the base title ID
# a 3D game: the 3D layout (a D-pad and a right stick), as Donkey Kong Bananza
# build IDs read from the packed 1.8.0 ExeFS (pack_dump.py of updates/917504)
# main imports from all three: subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie, subsdk1 the C library (profile_guess.py on the 1.8.0 ExeFS)
# a file of the 1.8.0 RomFS (the staff roll movie)
# compressed already: zstd archives (.zs, most of the RomFS), BWAV audio (20,991 files), WebM movies (57); and the shader libraries (.metallib), as Donkey Kong Bananza
# The NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: the survey's 5 GB block (profile_guess.py). The pool is the Switch 1's 3,285 MiB, not a
# Switch 2 measurement: the game sizes its heap from the pool (nninitStartup asked for 0x6b800000 with this pool and 0x1de400000 with a 9 GB one, the pool less about 1.53 GB).
# The heap check (as build_ipa_from_nsp.py heap_check, by hand: SetHeapSize OOM: req 0x6b800000 with the guessed 128 MB heap region) moved the split: a 1.75 GB heap region,
# the rest of the block the alias region. With it: [mem] heap 1.68 GB, and the sdk's address region node area maps the alias region up to +1.00 GB (SDK 21.4.0's AddressRegionManager
# matches none of sdk_patches.py's node area rules)
# 256 MB in front + 2.75 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 1.75 GB heap region
# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (main.npdm META +0x14): IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true
# the RomFS folders whose files hold BNSH (a scan of the 1.8.0 RomFS): Shader/ (six .bfsha.zs and Drive.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.release.sarc.zs), Effect/static.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.esetb.byml.zs,
# 90 Layout/*.blarc.zs; Lib/ (agl, gsys, Terrain, sead: BAHS / sharcb) stays in the group "other"
